label: TP
reason: User input from getQueryString() flows through substring and decode to 'param', which is passed to doSomething(). Inside doSomething(), the condition '(500 / 42) + 196 > 200' (evaluating to 207 > 200) is always true, causing 'bar' to equal 'param'. 'bar' is then concatenated directly into the SQL string ('PASSWORD=' + bar + '''). This lack of sanitization/escaping allows SQL Injection.

evidence.note: Input decoded but not sanitized for SQL
Parameter passed to inner class method
Math condition (500/42)+196>200 is always true, passing raw user input to bar
Variable bar concatenated directly into SQL string without escaping
